subheadings.rawText: Founding engineer with 4+ years building scalable, multi-tenant web applications end-to-end (database to UI) using \textbf{TypeScript}, \textbf{React/Next.js}, \textbf{Python/FastAPI}, and \textbf{PostgreSQL}. Shipped AI, real-time, and growth features across \textbf{88 tenants} and \textbf{38,000+ users} on \textbf{GCP}.

resumeItems: \textbf{Languages & Frameworks:} TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, React, Next.js, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Node.js
\textbf{Cloud & DevOps:} GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub), AWS (EC2, ElastiCache), Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions.
\textbf{Tools:} PostgreSQL, Redis, PostHog, Prometheus, React Query, Tailwind CSS, Firebase.

subheadings.position: Founding Engineer | Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Query, GCP
resumeItems: \textbf{AI & Real-time:} Engineered a crash-resistant medical AI scribe with IndexedDB persistence and exponential backoff (96.7% reliability) used across \textbf{83K+ sessions}, saving clinicians \textbf{11,000+ hours}. Built \textbf{WebSocket-driven patient status workflows} tracking \textbf{75K+ transitions} with a live waiting room dashboard used daily across clinics.

\textbf{Product & Growth:} Rewrote the patient booking flow serving \textbf{70K+ unique patients} with location-aware routing, driving a \textbf{63% MoM increase} to \textbf{3,800 bookings/month}. Built an end-to-end \textbf{email platform} with a reusable WYSIWYG composer, webhook-driven delivery tracking, and \textbf{blast campaigns} reaching \textbf{12,600+ recipients} across \textbf{47 clinics} processing \textbf{68K+ emails}.

\textbf{Platform Architecture:} Engineered a \textbf{design system} with semantic Tailwind variables, \textbf{dark mode}, and per-tenant \textbf{white-label branding} powering \textbf{38,000+ users} across \textbf{88 tenants}. Designed the drag-and-drop scheduling builder enabling \textbf{42+ clinics} to configure multi-provider workflows easier than any other EHR.

\textbf{Observability & DevOps:} Built the company's first analytics stack ingesting \textbf{29.2M events} via PostHog and Prometheus with a \textbf{95-event taxonomy}. Drove \textbf{React Query} adoption across the frontend, built CI/CD tooling with migration safeguards, and implemented MFA/auto-logout for \textbf{HIPAA/PHIPA} compliance.
